entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Work with repos, issues, pull requests and Actions on GitHub
entries.key_hint: Create a fine-grained personal access token at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens.
entries.permissions: Reaches GitHub with your token, so it can do what that token allows on your repositories.

entries.name: Context7
entries.description: Up-to-date library docs and code examples for prompts
entries.permissions: Sends library names and questions to Context7. It can't reach your files or accounts.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.description: Look up Sentry issues, errors and traces and get fix help
entries.permissions: Reads and updates the Sentry organizations your account can see.

entries.name: Filesystem
entries.description: Read, write and search files in the folder the chat works in
entries.permissions: Reads and writes files inside the chat's working folder only, on this computer.

entries.name: MarkItDown
entries.description: Convert files and links (PDF, Office, HTML and more) to Markdown
entries.permissions: Reads the files and links you give it, on this computer. Needs uv installed.

entries.name: Playwright
entries.description: Drive a real browser through Playwright page snapshots
entries.permissions: Opens its own browser on this computer and visits the sites the chat asks for.

entries.name: Chrome DevTools
entries.description: Control and inspect a live Chrome browser through DevTools
entries.permissions: Starts Chrome on this computer and can read anything open in that browser.

entries.name: Browser Use
entries.description: Control a real Chrome browser to finish web tasks
entries.permissions: Opens a browser on this computer and visits the sites the chat asks for. Needs uv installed.

entries.name: Supabase
entries.description: Manage Supabase projects, databases, migrations and edge functions
entries.permissions: Reads and changes the Supabase projects your account can reach, including their databases.

entries.name: MongoDB
entries.description: Query MongoDB databases, read-only
entries.key_hint: Paste your connection string (mongodb+srv://…), from Connect in Atlas.
entries.permissions: Reads the database your connection string opens. It starts read-only.

entries.name: Prisma
entries.description: Manage Prisma Postgres databases, migrations and backups
entries.permissions: Reads and changes the Prisma Postgres databases in your Prisma account.

entries.name: Apify
entries.description: Run Apify Actors to scrape websites and extract data
entries.permissions: Runs Actors in your Apify account, which can use its paid credits.

entries.name: Notion
entries.description: Search, read and edit Notion pages and databases
entries.permissions: Reads and edits the Notion pages you share with it when you sign in.

entries.name: Linear
entries.description: Find, create and update Linear issues, projects and comments
entries.permissions: Reads and edits issues in the Linear workspaces your account belongs to.

entries.name: Atlassian
entries.description: Work with Jira issues and Confluence pages
entries.permissions: Reads and edits the Jira and Confluence sites your Atlassian account can reach.

entries.name: Microsoft 365
entries.description: Work with Microsoft 365 mail, calendar, files, Teams and people
entries.permissions: Reads your Microsoft 365 data with your work account. Some access needs your admin's consent.

entries.name: Figma
entries.description: Pull Figma design context, variables and code
entries.permissions: Reads the Figma files your account can open.

entries.name: Stripe
entries.description: Use the Stripe API and search Stripe docs
entries.permissions: Reaches your Stripe account. Charges, refunds and payouts still stop for your approval in chat.

entries.name: Brave Search
entries.description: Web, news, image and local search through the Brave Search API
entries.permissions: Sends search queries to Brave with your API key.

entries.name: Exa
entries.description: AI web search, code search and page crawling
entries.permissions: Sends search queries and page links to Exa with your API key.

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.description: Manage Cloudflare accounts, Workers and services
entries.permissions: Reads and changes the Cloudflare accounts you sign in to.

entries.name: Cloudflare Docs
entries.description: Search Cloudflare's developer documentation
entries.permissions: Sends your questions to Cloudflare's docs search. It can't reach your account.

entries.name: Firebase
entries.description: Manage Firebase projects, Auth, Firestore and more
entries.permissions: Uses your Firebase CLI sign-in on this computer and can change those projects.

entries.name: Google Drive
entries.description: Search, read, create and share files in Google Drive
entries.permissions: Reads and changes the Drive files your Google account can open.

entries.name: Gmail
entries.description: Search threads, read mail and draft Gmail messages
entries.permissions: Reads your mail and writes drafts. Sending still stops for your approval in chat.

entries.name: Google Calendar
entries.description: List, search, create and update Google Calendar events
entries.permissions: Reads and changes events on the calendars your Google account can open.
